claim.text: New static first-argument float indexing improves native GNU Prolog execution time by at least 10% on a predetermined uniformly distributed 128-float-key synthetic workload relative to goal-expansion-only baseline.
claim.scope: GNU Prolog fork; Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64; compiled static first-argument float clauses; fixed synthetic generator.
assumptions: Both versions built with same configure/make/install settings on same runner
Semantic answer checks are necessary but not exhaustive.

specification.intended_object: Matched paired comparison of native execution time for old vs new compiler on identical source programs
invariants: WAM float switch only in candidate where float facts present
Same build flags and runner for both versions

implementation.environment: GitHub ubuntu-24.04 x86-64; 4 CPUs visible; Python 3.12.3
implementation.representation: Generated native Prolog fixtures, WAM inspection, compiled binaries, perf_counter_ns wall time, GNU time peak RSS

metric.name: Paired baseline/candidate wall-time speedup
equivalence_attacks: Float-free atom predicate in both compilers

black_box: Analytical expected total for every executed workload
Float indexing 13 native and 13 consulted tests on PR2
structural: Inspect generated WAM for switch_on_term_flt and switch_on_float
Inspect float-free WAM for historical switch_on_term
property_based: Deterministically generated permuted keys; no broad property-based guarantee
fuzzing: not applicable: no adversarial fuzz campaign conducted
historical: Goal expansion 29 semantic checks per native and consulted path

controls.compute_parity: Both builds same runner and configure/make/install; compiler feature is intended difference
controls.parameter_parity: Same input source and compile flags; resulting code sizes may differ
controls.sampling_parity: Seven alternating-order pairs, identical query schedule from seed 20261116, warmup before timing
controls.data_access_parity: Identical generated source bytes SHA-256 verified, same runner OS

preregistration.prediction: Candidate median baseline/candidate ratio at least 1.10 on float_uniform; atom-only control within 0.85..1.15
preregistration.primary_metric: Median of seven paired baseline/candidate native wall time ratios on float_uniform
preregistration.uncertainty_method: 2,000 seeded paired bootstrap resamples; descriptive within-run only
preregistration.kill_condition: Any answer mismatch, missing float WAM dispatch, primary median <1.10, bootstrap low <=1.0, or atom control outside parity band
preregistration.stop_condition: Do not generalize from synthetic measurements; additional scope requires real-workload and independent execution
preregistration.promotion_rule: Only bounded M if all correctness, dispatch and preregistered gates pass; no general speed claim
